title: The Second Tenant
original_pitch: A child in a lenticular family portrait spends her life switching between two poses as visitors pass. A cleaner lifts the frame and rocks it slowly. In the sliver between the approved views the child takes one unauthorized step out of line.
selection_justification: A lenticular portrait can use viewpoint as a prison and a sliver of angle as an escape.
adaptation: A lenticular-inspired family portrait shifts between two formal poses as the camera passes. A cleaner rocks the frame slowly. The smallest child steps out of the line and crosses the bottom edge of the picture.
story_beats: 4–8 s: turn reveals approved pose B
8–11 s: a slow frame rock exposes the in-between view
11–14 s: the child steps out beyond the picture
music_prompt: Fourteen second instrumental uncanny liberation. Celesta, muted chamber strings, soft bass clarinet. Restrained repeated formal phrase, a suspended middle sliver at eight seconds, a curious free ascending melody at eleven. Warm ending. No speech or vocals.
sfx_prompt: A heavy wooden picture frame gently creaks as it is tilted, cloth wiping glass, then three tiny clear wooden footsteps onto a table. No music or voices.
